pb.title: StarFlix — Playback
pb.tip: Automatic direct play: the site and the app report the codecs, 10-bit, HDR and audio the device plays, and the server avoids needless re-encoding. The optimized version is only generated within the time window (start = end: all day), one conversion at a time, and stops immediately when someone starts a playback that needs transcoding. Conservative turns this off (use it if a device has problems). Automatic (HDR): the site and the app report whether the screen is HDR; without that information, it converts. The conversion (tone-map) uses the CPU: a source above the maximum height is scaled down first. "Never convert" only stops forcing the conversion; if the file has to be re-encoded for another reason, tone-mapping still applies.
